prompt: Create a single-file HTML/JS high-precision interactive 3D black-hole simulator with clear gravitational lensing, a bright rotating accretion disk, a distinct black-hole shadow, mouse camera control, continuous animation, obvious left/right Doppler brightness asymmetry, no local dependencies, and a striking black-hole visual identity.
acceptance_criteria: single HTML/JS artifact runs in a modern browser
mouse interaction works and animation remains continuous
gravitational lensing is obvious and the rear disk is visibly folded around the shadow
the accretion disk reads as a disk rather than merely a glowing torus
left/right Doppler brightness asymmetry is clearly visible
the overall result is recognizably a striking black-hole simulation

prompt: Build a responsive dashboard UI for a monitoring product. Establish clear visual hierarchy, modern 1080p/2K layouts, responsive behavior, readable labels, and obvious hover, loading, empty, error, and selected states.
acceptance_criteria: layout remains usable at 1080p and 2K widths
primary information hierarchy is immediately readable
labels do not overlap or clip
hover, loading, empty, error, and selected states are visibly distinct

prompt: Create an interactive canvas/WebGL animation with strong visual impact, continuous motion, mouse or touch interaction, and reasonable runtime performance.
acceptance_criteria: animation remains continuous without fatal runtime errors
mouse or touch interaction has a visible effect
the main visual effect is clear at a glance
the implementation avoids unnecessary frame-time work
